sloka: प्लक्ष शाखासु यज्ञानाम् अन्येषाम् क्रियते हविः ।अश्व मेधस्य यज्ञस्य वैतसो भागः इष्यते ॥१-१४-३९॥
transliteration: plakṣa śākhāsu yajñānām anyeṣām kriyate haviḥ ।aśva medhasya yajñasya vaitaso bhāgaḥ iṣyate ॥1-14-39॥

translations.english: On the second day Ukthya and on the third day Atiraatra were performed. Many sacrifices fixed according to the scriptures were also performed.
